Petitioner(s) versus 1 - State Of Chhattisgarh Though The Under Education Mahanadi Secretary, Department, Bhawan, Mantralaya Atal Nagar, Naya Raipur (C.G.) 2 - Collector Food Department Branch, Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 3 - Sub Divisional Magistrate (R) Korba District Korba (C.G.) 4 - Block Division Education Officer Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 5 - Manu Kanta Principal Swami Atmananad English School, Balco Korba, District Korba (C.G.) 6 - Ekta Swa Sahayata Samuh Through Its President Sector-3 Balco, District Korba (C.G.) 7 - Kausal Prasad R/o Bhadrapara, Ward No. 40, Balco Nagar, District Korba (C.G.) 8 - Shakun Thakur R/o Bhadrapara, Ward No. 40, Balco Nagar, District Korba (C.G.) 9 - Anil Ratre Member Of Brc Korba District Korba (C.G.) 10 - Deepak Patel Naib Tahsildar Tahsil Korba, District Korba (C.G.) ---- Respondents ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- For Petitioner : Mr. Awadh Tripathi, Advocate. Ujala Mahila Swa-Sahayata Samuh vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 18 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11296520/ 1 For Respondent-State : Ms. Upasana Mehta, Dy. Ga. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Hon'ble Shri Arvind Kumar Verma, Judge Order on Board 18.07.2025 1.
texts.facts: That, the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this petition and quash the impugned orders dated may kindly be quash/set-aside the impugned order dated 13.06.2025 (ANNEXURE P/1), impugned order dated 13.06.2025 (ANNEXURE P/2) and impugned order dated 15.04.2025 (ANNEXURE P/3), in the interest of justice. 2. By the present writ petition, the petitioner is questioning the impugned order Annexure P/1 & P-2, by which, respondent-authority has terminated the allotment of the mid-day meal order which has been issued in favour of the petitioner.
texts.arguments: 10.3. Any other relief which deemed fit and proper may also be issued looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the interest of justice." 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that impugned order is a non-speaking order as same has been passed only on the basis of enquiry report and without giving proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. 4. Learned State Counsel submits that based on the complaint made with regard to the quality of the food supplied by the petitioner is not upto the mark, the Committee has been constituted to enquire the food quality supplied by the petitioner in the Swami Atmanand English School. The Inquiry Officer has made an enquiry and submitted the report vide Annexure P-3 before the concerned respondent-authority. The Committee has found that there is poor quality of food supplied by the petitioner and, thereafter, respondent-authority has passed the impugned order and detached the petitioner from the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in Swami Atmanand English School, Balco, Korba, District Korba, (CG). Learned State Counsel further contended that during the enquiry petitioner was not present on the spot, therefore, opportunity of hearing could not be given to him, however, respondent-authorities are ready to re-enquire the matter after providing proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. 6.

Learned State Counsel further contended that during the enquiry petitioner was not present on the spot, therefore, opportunity of hearing could not be given to him, however, respondent-authorities are ready to re-enquire the matter after providing proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner. 6.
